description: Header file defining interface and constants for MCP9808 temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register definitions, data structures, and function prototypes.

methods.name: mcp9808_reg_read
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit register value from the MCP9808 device.

methods.name: mcp9808_reg_write_16bit
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a register on the MCP9808 device.

methods.name: mcp9808_reg_write_8bit
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to a register on the MCP9808 device.

methods.name: mcp9808_temp_reg_from_signed
methods.description: Encodes a signed temperature in Celsius to the MCP9808 register format.

methods.name: mcp9808_temp_signed_from_reg
methods.description: Decodes a register temperature value to a signed Celsius temperature.
